{{Quote|The Deep Core is a maze full of anomalies that skew the senses! The task of finding one world within it is impossible!|[[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]]|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Deep Core''', also known as the '''Deep Galactic Core''', was a small region in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], about seven thousand [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] across and was home to some thirty billion of the galaxy's oldest [[Star/Legends|stars]], and at its center was a [[Galactic Center|supermassive black hole]] surrounded by [[antimatter]] and dense clusters where stars were only a hundredth of a light year apart. Thinly populated and largely inaccessible due to the [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] pull of the vast number of stars and the prominence of [[Dark matter/Legends|dark matter]] concentrations, with local space-time was severely warped, making [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel difficult at best. Nevertheless, the Deep Core held great strategic value because of its position near the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
==Astrography==
The Deep Core was defined as the central region of the galaxy where astrographic data became dangerously outdated within a [[standard month/Legends|standard month]] making hyperspace jumps hazardous. The [[Horizon]] formed this logical threshold that bounded the Deep Core. This definition made the Deep Core the only galactic region that was not shaped by colonization waves, politics, or culture, but by mathematics.<ref name="TEA" />

Coupled with the Deep Core's natural hazards, the Galactic Empire established an [[Imperial Hyperspace Security Net]], complete with [[Gravity mine/Legends|gravity mines]] and [[Jammer/Legends|jammers]] to inhibit communication and illegal spacers. Authorized spacers had to receive astrogation information, updated almost daily, from Imperial sources, in order to travel safely.<ref name="TEA" />

The Empire was mostly responsible for the region's surveying and colonization, in order to become an isolated stronghold for its elite with [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress worlds]]. It was also populated by [[Factory world/Legends|factory worlds]], [[Mining/Legends|mining worlds]] and agricultural colonies manned by slaves, prisoners and other outcasts. The isolation, dangerous nature, and function of the Deep Core, made it a source of dark rumors among spacers and citizens.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===Old Republic===
Despite the inaccessibility of the Deep Core, the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] still colonized [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] during the [[Pre-Republic era]] between [[35,000 BBY]] to [[25,200 BBY]]. With the collapse of the Infinite Empire,<ref name="TEA" /> Byss was presumably abandoned and the Rakatan structures crumbled over the millennia.<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> In [[36,453 BBY]], the [[Tho Yor]] brought [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1" /> philosophers and [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]]<ref name="History">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Galactic History}}</ref> to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], where they discovered [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and that it consisted of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Ashla]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Bogan]], eventually forming the [[Je'daii Order]] which focused on maintaining a balance of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in one's self.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1" /> In [[25,793 BBY]], the Rakata [[Invasion of the Tython system|invaded]] Tython.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 1]]</ref> They were expelled [[25,792 BBY|the following year]],<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 5">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 5]]</ref> but this was the start of<ref name="History /> the [[Force Wars]] between the followers of the Ashla and the followers of the Bogan. The war ended with the followers of the Ashla as the victors, who then established the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The newly formed Jedi Order left Tython<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> around [[25,783 BBY]]. The Jedi later settled on distant [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]<ref name="TORencyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />

Prior to [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]], [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]] was colonized by [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], who discovered vast deposits of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|system's]] seven worlds. The Korosians discovered that carbonite could be used to preserve space travelers in a state of [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]] for interstellar travel, leading to the development of [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] that enabled Humans to expand throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. With the discovery of carbonite and [[Andris/Legends|andris]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]], Koros Major prospered as a key base of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] shortly prior to the [[Unification Wars (Galactic Republic)|formation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[25,053 BBY]]. With the discovery of the [[Koros Trunk Line/Legends|Koros Trunk Line]] and the invention of the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], Republic [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] discovered a few habitable worlds within the volatile region including [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]] and [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]]. Over the millennia, Koros Major prospered from trade with Coruscant and became the largest settlement in the Deep Core frontier, developing into a vibrant [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]. Prior to the [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]], the Coruscant government owned the Korosian mines but sold them off to the emerging [[Tetan/Legends|Tetan]] aristocracy.<ref name="TEA" />

Following the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]],<ref name="time">In [[Legacy (2006) 30|''Legacy'' (2006) 30]], [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] says that "Some of Andeddu's achievements were built upon Muur's experiments" and that [[Karness Muur]] was a veteran of the Hundred-Year Darkness.</ref> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="Legacy 5">[[Legacy (2006) 5|''Legacy'' (2006) 5]]</ref> [[Darth Andeddu]] built a [[Andeddu's Keep|tomb]] on [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]].<ref name="SWL27">[[Legacy (2006) 27|''Legacy'' (2006) 27]]</ref> In [[5010 BBY]], [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]] of Koros Major waged a prolonged war to consolidate her world's control over the system's seven worlds, concluding her campaign in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] with the [[Battle of Kirrek (Unification Wars)|annexation]] of [[Kirrek]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], Koros and the red giant [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]] in the [[Primus Goluud system]] were the sites of battles between Empress Teta's forces and Dark Lord of the Sith [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. With the defeat of the Sith,<ref name="TOTJ: FOTSE">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire]]''</ref> Koros and its system were renamed Empress Teta and the Empress Teta system in honor of the Empress. Over the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] leading up to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], Koros prospered and became a strategic economic and military powerhouse within the Deep Core. In [[3997 BBY]], the aristocratic [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]] and [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] established the dark-side-using [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] sect, which seized control of the Empress Teta system during the early stages of the Sith War<ref name="DLOTS1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]]</ref> and launched the devastating [[Krath Holy Crusade]] that engulfed much of the Republic. With the defeat of the Krath and their [[Mandalorian Crusaders|Mandalorian]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] allies in [[3996 BBY]], Republic control was re-established over the Tetan system.<ref name="TNEC" />

In [[3651 BBY]], shortly after the [[Treaty of Coruscant|end]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|restored Sith Empire]], the Jedi Master [[Satele Shan]] discovered a [[Tython hyperspace route (Satele Shan)|new route]] to Tython.<ref name="The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural real-life book">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> The Jedi Order recolonized the planet and made it the new headquarters for the Order, since the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant had been destroyed in the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. A new generation of Jedi Knights was trained here, including the [[Hero of Tython]] and the [[The Barsen'thor|third Barsen'thor]]. The Hero of Tython earned this title by defending Tython against an [[Battle of the Oppressor|attack]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

[[File:Byss_FactFile.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Byss became one of several fortress worlds in the Deep Core.]]
At some point the Jedi once again abandoned Tython. The region was thought to be inaccessible, but certain individuals found other safe [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] into the region, such as the [[Byss Run/Legends|Byss Run]] and the [[Deep Core Run]], over the millennia. During the [[New Sith Wars]], the Dark Lord of the Sith [[Belia Darzu]] rediscovered Tython and build a [[Belia Darzu's fortress|secret fortress]] there. [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] visited the fortress in [[990 BBY]] during his search for the key to making [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]]. Bane's apprentice [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] was followed to Tython by a group of Jedi led by [[Valenthyne Farfalla]], but the two Sith [[Duel on Tython|killed]] those Jedi.<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> In [[980 BBY]], Darth Bane [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Bane)|traveled]] to Prakith to recover [[Holocron of Heresies|Darth Andeddu's holocron]] from the [[Malevolence (cult)|Malevolence]] [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]].<ref name="DOE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

===Clone Wars===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] dispatched scouts and [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] to explore the Deep Core. As the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious, he provided the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] with access to secret the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]] that allowed them to bypass the heavily defended [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] and [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Imperial Era===
[[File:DeepCore-FDCR.png|thumb|left|200px|An Imperial Star Destroyer traveling through the Deep Core]]
[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] forced and coordinated successful colonization efforts in the Deep Core.<ref name="TEA" />

During the early [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress worlds]], top-secret [[shipyard]]s, bases and palaces on several Deep Core worlds. Classified Imperial records indicate that Imperial scouts discovered hundreds of habitable worlds within the region but were permanently eliminated to maintain this secret. Some of these new worlds, including Prakith and Byss, were selected for Imperial colonization efforts and settled by wealthy Imperial loyalists. Palpatine also nationalized the carbonite mines of Empress Teta and used the planet as a base for probe droids and scouting missions.<ref name="TEA" />

The Empire declared the entire region a security zone, and all [[Starship/Legends|starships]] entering or exiting the region required authorization from the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] (BoSS) and the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB). The former was responsible for policing the space-lanes while the latter was tasked with protecting [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] secrets. Hyperspace jumps were also restricted with [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] required to report to Imperial authorities and receive frequent [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] updates. The [[15th Deep Core Reserve Fleet/Legends|15th Deep Core Reserve Fleet]], lead by Admiral [[Malfkla Yzu]], was based in the Deep Core.<ref name="TEA" />

===The New Republic===
Despite the Empire's fall, the Deep Core remained a stronghold for several Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], including [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]] and [[Lord High Admiral]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]], came to dominate the Deep Core. In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the reborn [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] Palpatine used Byss as a staging ground to invade the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. Byss also became the site of the world-destroying [[Galaxy Gun]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], which destroyed several New Republic targets. Following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final death]] of Palpatine at [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], Byss and the Galaxy Gun were [[Destruction of Byss|destroyed]] during a hyperspace collision with the Emperor's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Eclipse II]]'', dealing a heavy blow to Imperial forces in the region.<ref name="TEA" />

The remaining warlords squabbled among themselves until they were [[Imperial Reunification|slain]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] during a conference at [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]]. Delvardus' [[Eriadu Authority]] began construction of a modified [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] named ''[[Knight Hammer|Night Hammer]]'', later renamed ''Knight Hammer'' by Daala. The ''Knight Hammer'' later served as a primary [[Command ship/Legends|command vessel]] for the [[United Warlord Fleets]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Foga Brill/Legends|Foga Brill]] established his own [[Constitutional Protectorate of Prakith|dictatorship on Prakith]] as a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] against the New Republic. However, the latter preferred to contain the Imperial warlords, and Prakith was overthrown during a coup by moderate elements that made peace with the Republic. After the execution of the warlords, Admiral [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] traveled to [[Deep 3]], a secret shipyard run by deceased warlord Blizter Harrsk. Pellaeon found a cache of [[Mine/Legends|mines]], robotic TIE fighters, weapons, and perhaps the most prized weapons, two [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]], named ''[[Megador]]'' and ''[[Dominion (Star Dreadnought)|Dominion]]''.<ref name="TEA" />

===Later eras===
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] leader Gilad Pellaeon supplied the Republic with information on secret Imperial hyperspace routes in the region. Using this information, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] planned a [[Battle of Ebaq|trap]] for the [[Yuuzhan Vong|aliens]], drawing them into the difficult-to-navigate region.<ref name="TEA" />

In [[137 ABY]], Prakith was visited by [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok the Third]] who destroyed Darth Andeddu while on a [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Wyyrlok)|mission]] to find a cure for his master [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Yorik-Kul|illness]].<ref name="SWL27" />
